salient_findings: Inferior displacement of the cerebellar tonsils on MRI
Ventral cervicothoracic epidural CSF collection on CTM
key_facts: MRI Head showed inferior displacement of the cerebellar tonsils
CTM showed extradural contrast spread at multiple cervical and thoracic levels
Ventral cervicothoracic epidural CSF collection extending from mid cervical spine to mid thoracic level
No specific physical examination findings were reported

raw.rationale: The patient's worsening headaches upon standing and the imaging findings of extradural contrast spread and ventral cervicothoracic epidural CSF collection are consistent with spontaneous intracranial hypotension, which is often caused by a cerebrospinal fluid leak.

rejected.label: Chiari malformation type I
rejected.why: While the MRI shows inferior displacement of the cerebellar tonsils, which is a characteristic of Chiari malformation type I, the patient's symptoms and other imaging findings are more consistent with spontaneous intracranial hypotension.

rejected.label: Syringomyelia
rejected.why: There is no mention of a syrinx in the spinal cord, which is a characteristic finding in syringomyelia.

rejected.label: Cerebrospinal fluid leak
rejected.why: While a cerebrospinal fluid leak is likely present, it is not a diagnosis, but rather a cause of spontaneous intracranial hypotension.

rejected.label: Intracranial hypotension syndrome
rejected.why: This is a broader term that encompasses spontaneous intracranial hypotension, but spontaneous intracranial hypotension is a more specific diagnosis that better explains the patient's symptoms and imaging findings.
